scope: same 20 fixed 3+1 chain geometries as v0.2; fresh independent counts; fixed labels and known density
independent_observable_cells: 19 unchanged atoms plus the union of atoms (4,6) and (5,6); exact invertible transform of the 20 observed counts
bound: correlation-preserving first derivative, square-root Taylor remainder and exact quadratic inverse remainder; Frobenius upper bounds
certificate: outward Decimal interval evaluation at 60 significant digits; q_lower*121 >= qhat_upper*100 and q_upper*81 <= qhat_lower*100
candidate_policy: float scan of all observations; all positive candidates undergo directed-rounding verification; noncandidates remain uncertified, never silently removed
certificate_availability_gate: At primary density, each geometry has a one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound >=0.90 on certificate availability, Bonferroni alpha=0.05 across 20 geometries
comparison: v0.2 bound on the same fresh counts; all observations retained
validation: finite-difference derivative and independent high-precision spot checks
90-digit repeat of first and last certificate per geometry-density cell
no_claims: conditional coverage after selecting certified cases
